latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AgResource Newsletter Scraper.

- Scrapes daily AgResource grain marketing newsletters (morning, noon, evening, weekend) after logging in automatically.
- Summarizes content, extracts news, sales advice, grain positioning, and generates concise overviews for each issue.
- Analyzes and tracks price-impact sentiment trends (bullish/bearish etc) and stores history for comparison.
- Detects and alerts on changes in sales advice via Telegram; always saves summaries and sentiment data.
- Supports manual and scheduled/cron-based operation, with flexible commands for summary, detail, and sentiment queries.
- Files and data stored in organized local directories for easy access and traceability.
